paragraphs: Minimalist CV is a straightforward web application designed to generate a minimalist and print-friendly CV page built with Next.js and Shadcn UI.
Setting up the CV page is efficient and requires only a single configuration file.
Developed using Next.js 14, React, TypeScript, Shadcn UI, and Tailwind CSS.
The CV page comes with an automatically generated layout for a clean and minimalist design. The layout is responsive, ensuring optimal viewing on different devices.
The application is optimized for use with Next.js and seamlessly deployed on a Vercel platform.
Overall, Minimalist CV provides an easy-to-use solution for individuals looking to create a minimalist and professionally styled CV with a focus on print-friendly design.
